text:
Priya N.: hey team :wave: prepping the evidence bundle for ISO audit next sprint. quick ask — who owns the audit-log retention config (S3 lifecycle + retention window)? need owner to sign off before dry-run
Marco L.: I can take point on the S3 lifecycle policy. can someone confirm the target retention window? 7 years or 6? :thinking_face:
Ava - Security: ISO wants documented retention mapping per control. For audit logs we said 7 years in the control matrix. Priya can you attach the matrix here? :eyes:
Priya N.: attaching the matrix in the bundle shortly. also need the exact S3 path where infra will stage evidence for the auditors. Marco, any preference for bucket/prefix?
Jordan (Infra): please use: `s3://redwood-audit-evidence/iso/2026/keystore/` — we have a lifecycle rule ready, snippet below. I'll push the policy in a PR today.
Jordan (Infra): ```json
{
  "Rules": [{
    "ID": "audit-logs-retention",
    "Status": "Enabled",
    "Filter": {"Prefix": "iso/2026/keystore/"},
    "Expiration": {"Days": 2555}
  }]
}
```
Priya N.: perfect. Marco, can you confirm the Days value maps to 7 years? (2555 correct)
Marco L.: yep 365*7 = 2555, good to go. i'll review the PR once Jordan opens it.
Ava - Security: also need an owner for the evidence handoff runbook during fieldwork. @Jordan can ops be on call for the first smoke?
Jordan (Infra): ops can be on call. i'd like someone from product or SRE to join the first hour. @Marco L. any volunteers?
Marco L.: i'll be available for the first hour of the smoke test. :thumbsup:
Priya N.: thanks. next: we need a code review + approval for the keystore auditlog ingest changes — can the team tag the PR with `audit-evidence` label and assign reviewers?
Jordan (Infra): will do. expecting to open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823 (draft) — includes lifecycle + IAM role change for read-only access for auditors.
Ava - Security: quick checklist from my side before sign-off:
- retention rule in place :white_check_mark:
- documented owner and on-call for smoke :white_check_mark:
- evidence path confirmed :white_check_mark:
- IAM separation + least privilege reviewed :needs_review:
Please flag the IAM snippet in the PR for me to review specifically.
Priya N.: noted. i'll add the matrix + handoff SOP to the PR description and tag the auditors mailing list.
sec-bot: Incident-bot: reminder: dry-run automated smoke scheduled for 2026-04-12 14:00 UTC. Please ensure assigned owners are on-call.
Marco L.: added to my calendar.
Priya N.: thanks all — i'll follow up with the PR link and evidence bundle artifact once available. if anyone needs to swap on-call, ping here. :pray:
